summary: Full backend + frontend testing of XAUUSD real-time signals dashboard. All 9 backend pytest cases passed (price tradingview/goldapi, sessions, multi-timeframe with all 7 TFs and required indicators, strength, active signal idempotency, history, binary next-candle, stats). Frontend dashboard loads, renders 3-column layout, live price ticker shows numeric value (~$4538), source selector toggles correctly between TradingView and Gold-API (price source label and value updated), all 7 timeframe buttons present and clickable, market sessions show Sydney/Tokyo/London/New York with active flags, active signal card renders BUY/SELL state correctly with TP1/TP2/TP3, SL, confidence and analysis. Spanish UI confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses pandas .resample('4H') which is deprecated in pandas 2.2+ (use '4h'); works for now but may emit FutureWarning.

_make_signal: when timeframe is set but analysis is NEUTRAL, response signal field becomes null; OK per spec but client UX shows 'Mercado neutral' only if returned signal is null AND no STATE['active_signal'] for that TF — current code returns STATE['active_signal'] check using new_sig.id which may be incorrect when active signal exists for different TF. Edge case worth reviewing.
In-memory state means stats/history reset on backend restart — acceptable per user choice (no MongoDB).

yfinance GC=F (Gold Futures) used for indicators while spot price comes from TradingView — small price differential (~$30-50) is expected and TPs/SLs computed against spot price which is the correct UX choice.
seed_data_creation: None - signals self-generate from live market data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass against public URL. UI fully verified at https://xauusd-trader-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com. data-testid attributes present: dashboard-root, live-price-ticker, active-signal-card, multi-timeframe-panel, tf-{1m,5m,15m,30m,1h,4h,1d}, source-selector, market-sessions-panel.
